text:
mike_sre: Observed a ~20% 5xx spike for hosted inference API starting ~10:42 UTC after the route-policy rollout to canary. Canary nodes are showing the highest error rates.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/route-policy@v2 -> canary(10%) at 10:40 UTC (sha ab12cd).

emily_support: getting 4 customer tickets tied to this, examples: org=acme-corp, req_id=r12345 -> 502 gateway; org=zonex, req_id=r67890 -> timeout then 503. Customers report latency then 5xx.

raj_prod: Can we pause traffic / rollback? Recommend full rollback to v1 for hosted tier until triage. :warning:

olivia_releases: Starting rollback now per runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-5xx. Capturing deploy logs and metrics. @mike_sre can you paste a minimal repro/log snippet?

mike_sre: Attaching a quick log sample and a repro curl. Noticed header routing mismatch and backend 502.

```
[10:42:13] gateway edgesrv-12 - req_id=r12345 - route=default - backend=upstream-a - status=502 - error="upstream read timeout"
[10:42:14] gateway edgesrv-07 - req_id=r12346 - route=route-v2 - status=502 - error="no backend bound"
```

Repro:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "x-route-signal: " 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" --data '{"model":"ggml-redwood","input":"hi"}'
# response -> 502 gateway or hang until timeout
```

mike_sre: Quick triage notes: requests with an empty or missing `x-route-signal` are being evaluated as v2 due to a short-circuit in the canary evaluator. Looks like the config flag `route_signal_split` is evaluating truthy for uninitialized headers in the edge path.

raj_prod: If it's a flag evaluation bug we should revoke the flag immediately and roll back. Olivia, confirm when rollback completes so we can notify customers.

olivia_releases: Rollback executed at 10:50 UTC -> canary stopped, traffic pinned to route-policy@v1 for hosted. Metrics and error rates are returning to baseline. :white_check_mark:

emily_support: Thanks. I've messaged the impacted customers to confirm rollback. Will escalate if they see further errors.

mike_sre: Post-rollback numbers look healthy. 5xx down to baseline. I'll open a bug to fix flag eval order and add a unit test for header-defaulting in edge code. Closing incident thread unless we get further reports.
